articles.summary: The Virtualizor supply-chain compromise shows how a BGP hijack can defeat TLS, bypass RPKI and multi-perspective validation, and expose millions of websites through permissive route configurations.
articles.title: The Virtualizor Attack: An Unmitigated Threat Affecting Millions of Websites

articles.summary: Contextually aware cyber safeguards can make judgments based on information an adversary controls. That raises questions about how much protection they provide when prompts and external content can be manipulated.
articles.title: The risks of contextually-aware safeguards
